name: Complete the Al Kharid Rooftop Course

evidence.note: Complete the lap through the final rooftop obstacle.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Land after completing the Al Kharid rooftop lap.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Recover from a fall and complete a fresh lap.

name: Grapple across the River Lum

evidence.note: Equip a capable crossbow and the mith grapple. The draft reserves the supported mithril crossbow.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Cross the river and see the diary registration.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Recover the grapple or replace it if it breaks.

name: Buy Ava’s accumulator

evidence.note: Use the separate full-price purchase. The quest’s generic device record leaves the attractor exchange for later review.

name: Use a fairy ring to reach the Wizards’ Tower

evidence.note: Dial DIS once fairy rings are unlocked. The normal fairy-ring trip can register the same task.

name: Cast Lumbridge Teleport

evidence.note: Cast the standard spell. Other modeled casts can register the same credit.

name: Catch a salmon in the River Lum in Lumbridge

evidence.note: Use the Lumbridge lure spot. The route debits one feather for the successful catch.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Catch a salmon at the Lumbridge spot.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep fishing with spare feathers if you catch a trout.

name: Craft a coif in the Lumbridge cow pen

evidence.note: Craft the coif inside the cow pen. Reserve one thread for the craft.

name: Chop a willow log in Draynor Village

evidence.note: Collect the first successfully cut log from a Draynor willow.

name: Pickpocket Martin the Master Gardener

evidence.note: Count fixed Thieving XP when the pickpocket succeeds. Seed loot varies.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Successfully pickpocket Martin and see diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wait out the stun or finish any dialogue that prevents pickpocketing.

name: Get a Slayer assignment from Chaeldar

evidence.note: Ask Chaeldar in Zanaris for a new assignment.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Receive a new assignment from Chaeldar.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Finish or clear the active task before asking again.

name: Catch an essence impling in Puro-Puro

evidence.note: Use the Puro-Puro net-and-jar route. Later Hunter levels also permit an eclectic impling.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Catch an essence impling in Puro-Puro and confirm diary credit.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Continue searching in the maze until the catch succeeds.

name: Craft a lava rune at the Fire Altar

evidence.note: Use an earth talisman on the Fire Altar with an earth rune and pure essence. A binding necklace can prevent failure.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Create a lava rune at the Fire Altar.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Replace any consumed ingredients and try again if the combination fails.

name: Have the Varrock Apothecary make a strength potion

evidence.note: Pay the Apothecary five coins and hand over the ingredients.

name: Enter the Champions’ Guild

evidence.note: Enter the guild with 32 quest points. The ordinary entrance also registers this task.

name: Choose a kitten colour with Gertrude

evidence.note: Wear the activated Ring of charos, select the kitten’s colour, and pay Gertrude.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Gertrude lets the player select a colour and hands over the kitten.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Make room for a new pet and ask again while wearing the ring.

name: Travel from the Grand Exchange Spirit Tree

evidence.note: Depart from the Grand Exchange tree after Tree Gnome Village.

name: Cast Varrock Teleport

evidence.note: Cast the standard spell to Varrock Square. Other real casts can register the same credit.

name: Get a Slayer assignment from Vannaka

evidence.note: Ask the Slayer master in Edgeville Dungeon for a new assignment.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Receive a new assignment from Vannaka.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Finish or clear the active task before asking again.

name: Turn 20 mahogany logs into planks in one sawmill order

evidence.note: Pay for all twenty regular mahogany plank conversions in the same order.

name: Take a balloon flight departing Varrock

evidence.note: Use a routine flight from Varrock to Entrana. Any routine departure from Varrock registers the task.

name: Complete the Varrock Rooftop Course

evidence.note: Complete a full Varrock lap and land at the final obstacle.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Land after a full lap and receive diary registration.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Recover from a fall and complete a fresh lap.

name: Buy a mithril crossbow and mith grapple

evidence.note: Buy these quantities using the fixed planning budget. Actual GE fills vary.

name: Buy Ava’s 75 steel arrows

evidence.note: Buy these quantities using the fixed planning budget. Actual GE fills vary.

name: Buy Lumbridge Medium crafting, hunting and altar supplies

evidence.note: Buy these quantities using the fixed planning budget. Actual GE fills vary.

name: Buy ingredients for the Varrock Apothecary

evidence.note: Buy these quantities using the fixed planning budget. Actual GE fills vary.

name: Buy twenty mahogany logs for Varrock Sawmill

evidence.note: Buy these quantities using the fixed planning budget. Actual GE fills vary.

name: Confirm all tasks for Lumbridge & Draynor Medium Diary

evidence.note: Record the Medium milestone after all registered tasks. The NPC checks the Easy claim at handover.

name: Claim Lumbridge & Draynor Medium Diary rewards

evidence.note: Complete the separate Medium handover after claiming the Easy tier.

name: Confirm all tasks for Varrock Medium Diary

evidence.note: Record the Medium milestone after all registered tasks. The NPC checks the Easy claim at handover.

name: Claim Varrock Medium Diary rewards

evidence.note: Complete the separate Medium handover after claiming the Easy tier.

name: Buy Zaff’s Varrock Medium battlestaff stock

evidence.note: Pay 7,000 per staff in one daily stock purchase. The draft uses one shared stock window across tiers.
